DLG-SC-LOC-011-12-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-12-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計はご一緒でよろしいですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-011-12-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-12-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人別々に払いたいです。注文した物ごとに分けられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-12-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人の別会計を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-12-001-SHARED-02.translation: We'd like to pay separately. Can you divide it by what each person ordered?
DLG-SC-LOC-011-12-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about separate payment for two people.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-12-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-12-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 伝票を見て、ご希望を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-12-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll look at the bill and confirm your wishes.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-12-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-12-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私はこの定食、友人はパスタです。この二つは分けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-12-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分と友人の注文を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-12-001-SHARED-04.translation: I had this set meal and my friend the pasta. We'd like those separated.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-12-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Identify your and your friend's orders in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-12-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-12-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それぞれのお食事を分けます。サラダはどちらの方でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-12-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll separate each meal. Whose is the salad?

DLG-SC-LOC-011-12-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-12-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二人で食べました。サラダだけ半分の金額ずつにできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-12-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 共通料理を半分ずつ分けられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-12-001-SHARED-06.translation: We shared it. Can just the salad's cost be divided in half?
DLG-SC-LOC-011-12-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether a shared dish can be split equally.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-12-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-12-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この会計では一品を二つの支払いへ分けられません。どちらかに含める形ならできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-12-001-SHARED-07.translation: At this checkout, we can't divide one item across two payments. We can include it with one person's bill.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-12-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-12-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ではサラダは私の方へお願いします。友人との分担は、後で二人で決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-12-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 品目分割不可を受け共通料理は自分が払うと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-12-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then put the salad on mine, please. My friend and I will decide how to share that afterwards.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-12-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: After learning item splitting is unavailable, decide in Japanese to pay the shared dish yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-12-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-12-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お客様は定食とサラダ、ご友人はパスタです。こちらが二枚の明細です。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-12-001-SHARED-09.translation: You have the set meal and salad, and your friend pasta. Here are the two itemized bills.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-12-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-12-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その内容で合っています。私から先に支払い、友人は自分の明細で払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-12-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二人の明細を確定して順番に支払う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-12-001-SHARED-10.translation: That's correct. I'll pay first, and my friend will pay their own bill.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-12-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the two bills and pay in order in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-12-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-12-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二つのお会計に分けました。まず、定食とサラダの金額はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-12-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've separated the two payments. First, here is the set-meal and salad amount.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-13-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-13-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの盆栽をご覧になっていますね。

DLG-SC-LOC-011-13-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-13-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 形と名前を一緒に写真へ残したいですが、枝で名札が隠れています。撮り方を相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-13-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 樹形と名札を一緒に撮る方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-13-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like a photograph showing the shape and name together, but the branches hide the label. May I ask about how to take it?
DLG-SC-LOC-011-13-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese how to photograph the tree shape and label together.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-13-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-13-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 枝や鉢には触れず、ご自身の立つ位置を変えてご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-13-001-SHARED-03.translation: Without touching branches or pot, change your own standing position to look.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-13-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-13-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 少し枝をよければと思いましたが、触らずに撮ります。右からなら札が見えそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-13-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 枝を動かしたい考えを取り下げる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-13-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought of moving a branch a little, but I'll photograph without touching. From the right the label may be visible.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-13-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Withdraw the idea of moving branches in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-13-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-13-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通路の範囲で右へ回れます。後ろのお客様にもお気を付けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-13-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can go right within the passage. Be careful of visitors behind you too.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-13-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-13-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ここで立ち止まって撮ってもよいですか。三脚は使わず、スマホだけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-13-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通路内で別の撮影位置を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-13-001-SHARED-06.translation: May I stop here for a photo? No tripod, just my phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-13-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about another photo position within the walkway.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-13-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-13-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 撮影の表示に沿って、通路を空けてお撮りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-13-001-SHARED-07.translation: Follow the photography signs and keep the passage clear while photographing.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-13-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-13-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 右側は逆光なので、全体の写真と名札の写真を別々に撮ります。後で同じ番号を付ければ分かりますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-13-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 逆光なら全体と札を別写真にする提案をする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-13-001-SHARED-08.translation: The right side is backlit, so I'll photograph the whole tree and label separately. Giving them the same number later should identify them.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-13-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Suggest in Japanese separate overall and label photos in backlighting.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-13-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-13-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 展示に番号の札があります。ご自分のメモで、二枚が対応するようにしておくとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-13-001-SHARED-09.translation: The exhibit has a numbered tag. Use your notes to match the two photographs.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-13-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-13-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 番号を控えて二枚撮ります。撮り終えたらここを空け、休憩場所でメモをまとめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-13-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 非接触の二枚撮影と通路を空ける段取りを決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-13-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll note the number and take two photos. Then I'll clear this spot and organize notes at the rest area.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-13-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide in Japanese on two non-contact photos and clearing the walkway afterwards.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-13-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-13-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ、周囲を確認してお撮りください。展示物はそのままで、続きをお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-13-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check your surroundings and photograph. Leave the exhibit as it is and enjoy the rest.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-14-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-14-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 体験展示のご案内です。お子さんの年齢をお伺いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-14-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is guidance for the hands-on exhibit. May I ask your child's age?

DLG-SC-LOC-011-14-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-14-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 背が高いので、大人の台にも届きます。この体験をしてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-14-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 背の高い子が体験できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-14-001-SHARED-02.translation: They're tall, so can reach the adult console too. May they try this activity?
DLG-SC-LOC-011-14-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether your tall child may try the activity.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-14-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-14-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 手が届くかではなく、案内にある対象年齢で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-14-001-SHARED-03.translation: We check the stated age requirement, not whether they can reach.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-14-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-14-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 六歳です。身長だけでは決められないんですね。この案内の年齢にはまだ達していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-14-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 身長ではなく年齢条件と理解し実年齢を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-14-001-SHARED-04.translation: Six. So height alone doesn't decide it. They haven't reached the age on this notice yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-14-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the actual age in Japanese and acknowledge the age condition rather than height.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-14-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-14-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 本日は操作体験には参加できません。実演を見学することはできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-14-001-SHARED-05.translation: They can't participate in operating today. They can watch the demonstration.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-14-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-14-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それなら見学したいです。子どもが触らずに見られる場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-14-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 条件を変えず見学できる範囲を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-14-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then we'd like to watch. Please tell us where my child can see without touching.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-14-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about permitted viewing without changing the conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-14-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-14-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの線の後ろからご覧ください。開始前に係員が説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-14-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please watch from behind this line. Staff will explain before starting.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-14-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-14-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 子どもには、今日は自分で操作せず係の人の動きを見ると伝えます。分からない所は私から質問してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-14-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 操作せず実演を見ることを子へ説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-14-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll tell my child today they watch the staff's movements without operating it themselves. May I ask about anything unclear?
DLG-SC-LOC-011-14-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese to your child that they will watch the demonstration without operating.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-14-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-14-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。実演が終わった後に、お聞きできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-14-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, you may ask after the demonstration.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-14-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-14-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 線の後ろで実演を見て、終わったら質問します。その後は年齢に合う別の展示へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-14-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 代替見学後に別展示へ進むと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-14-001-SHARED-10.translation: We'll watch from behind the line and ask afterwards. Then we'll visit another age-appropriate exhibit.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-14-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide in Japanese to watch the alternative demonstration then move to another exhibit.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-14-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-14-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では見学の場所へどうぞ。次の展示の案内も、実演後にご覧いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-14-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then go to the viewing place. Information for the next exhibit is also available after the demonstration.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-15-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-15-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お足元が濡れていますね。園路のことでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-15-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your shoes are wet. Is this about the garden path?

DLG-SC-LOC-011-15-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-15-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 落ち葉の所を歩いたら、水たまりが隠れていました。先へ行く前に別の道を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-15-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 落ち葉道で靴が濡れたと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-15-001-SHARED-02.translation: A puddle was hidden where I walked over fallen leaves. Before going further, please show me another route.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-15-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about shoes wet on the leaf-covered path.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-15-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-15-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どちらから歩いて来られましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-15-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which direction did you walk from?

DLG-SC-LOC-011-15-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-15-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 池の南側からです。小さな橋を過ぎて、右の木の下で濡れました。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-15-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入口と水があった位置を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-15-001-SHARED-04.translation: The pond's south side. Past the small bridge, I got wet beneath the tree on the right.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-15-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese the approach and where the water was.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-15-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-15-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その先にも土の部分があります。舗装の道へ戻る案内をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-15-001-SHARED-05.translation: There is more dirt path ahead. I'll direct you back to the paved route.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-15-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-15-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 濡れた靴で土道を続けたくありません。近くの舗装路へ出る経路をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-15-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 先も歩けるかでなく舗装路への戻り方を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-15-001-SHARED-06.translation: I don't want to continue on dirt with wet shoes. Please show the route to nearby pavement.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-15-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for the way back to pavement rather than whether you can continue ahead.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-15-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-15-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この分岐まで戻り、入口の方向へお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-15-001-SHARED-07.translation: Return to this junction and go toward the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-15-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-15-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同行者が先に歩いています。分岐の表示の名前を伝えて、そこで合流したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-15-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同行者へ変更を知らせるため分岐名を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-15-001-SHARED-08.translation: My companion is ahead. I'd like to tell them the junction sign's name and meet there.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-15-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the junction name in Japanese to tell your companion about the change.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-15-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-15-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 表示は南園路です。写真で現在地も送ると伝わりやすいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-15-001-SHARED-09.translation: The sign says South Garden Path. Sending a photo of your location also makes it clearer.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-15-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-15-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 南園路の分岐へ戻ると連絡します。合流後は舗装路で短く歩いて帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-15-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 舗装路で短い散歩に切替える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-15-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll tell them I'm returning to the South Garden Path junction. After meeting, we'll take a short paved walk and go home.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-15-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Switch in Japanese to a short walk on pavement.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-15-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-15-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの地図をお持ちください。滑る所は無理に進まず、足元を見てお戻りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-15-001-SHARED-11.translation: Take this map. Don't force your way over slippery spots; watch your step while returning.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-16-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-16-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 案内図でお探しの場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-16-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there somewhere you're looking for on the guide map?

DLG-SC-LOC-011-16-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-16-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この絵の城を見たいのですが、建物が見えません。どちらへ行けばありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-16-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 図の城を見たいが建物が見つからないと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-16-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to see the castle in this picture, but can't see the building. Which way is it?
DLG-SC-LOC-011-16-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese where the castle building in the diagram is.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-16-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-16-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この図は昔の配置を説明する物です。描いた建物がそのまま残っているという意味ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-16-001-SHARED-03.translation: This diagram explains the former layout. It doesn't mean the drawn buildings remain as they are.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-16-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-16-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昔の様子だったんですね。今ある建物を探して、同じ所を何度も歩いていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-16-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昔の配置図と現存建物の違いを理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-16-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it shows the old appearance. I kept walking the same place looking for a current building.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-16-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge in Japanese the difference between the former layout and surviving buildings.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-16-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-16-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在見られる跡や地形は、こちらの案内にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-16-001-SHARED-05.translation: This guide shows remains and terrain visible now.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-16-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-16-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は一か所だけ、実際の形が分かる所を見たいです。どの跡を選ぶと案内と比べやすいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-16-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今見られる地形を一か所選びたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-16-001-SHARED-06.translation: Today I'd like just one place where I can see the actual shape. Which remains are easy to compare with the guide?
DLG-SC-LOC-011-16-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to choose one terrain feature visible now.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-16-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-16-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この土塁の案内板から、目の前の高まりをご覧いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-16-001-SHARED-07.translation: From this earthwork explanation board, you can view the raised ground in front of you.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-16-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-16-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 案内板の線と、この盛り上がった部分を比べるんですね。建物に登る場所ではないと分かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-16-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内板と目の前の地形を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-16-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I compare the board's lines with this raised part. I understand it isn't somewhere to climb a building.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-16-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Compare the explanation board and terrain before you in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-16-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-16-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。見学は園路からお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-16-001-SHARED-09.translation: Correct. Please view from the garden path.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-16-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-16-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 園路から土塁を見て、案内を読みます。今日はその一か所で、昔の配置を想像して帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-16-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 選んだ跡を見て説明を読み帰ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-16-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll view the earthwork from the path and read the guide. Today I'll imagine the former layout at just that place, then go home.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-16-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide in Japanese to see the chosen remains, read the explanation and leave.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-16-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-16-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: この図をお持ちください。説明と今の地形を照らし合わせてお楽しみいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-16-001-SHARED-11.translation: Take this diagram. You can enjoy comparing the explanation and current terrain.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-17-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-17-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日はご入浴でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-011-17-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-17-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族は入りますが、私は食事だけにしたいです。入浴しない場合もここで受付しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-17-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 入浴しない食事利用を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-17-001-SHARED-02.translation: My family will, but I'd like only a meal. Do I check in here if I don't bathe too?
DLG-SC-LOC-011-17-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about meal-only use without bathing.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-17-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-17-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それぞれのご利用内容を確認します。ご家族と同じ券を希望されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-17-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll confirm each person's usage. Are you requesting the same ticket as your family?

DLG-SC-LOC-011-17-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-17-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ。私はお風呂を使いません。同じ人数だから全員入浴だと伝えてしまったなら直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-17-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族は入浴し本人はしないと分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-17-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. I won't use the baths. If I gave the impression everyone would bathe just because we're the same group, please correct it.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-17-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Separate in Japanese the bathing family from yourself not bathing.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-17-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-17-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 食事だけのご利用について、本日の受付方法を担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-17-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll ask the person responsible about today's registration for meal-only use.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-17-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-17-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。入浴の料金を払ってから返してもらうより、最初に区分を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-17-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 食事利用の入館扱いを担当へ確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-17-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please. Rather than pay bathing admission and then ask for it back, I'd like to check the category first.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-17-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for staff to confirm entry treatment for meal use.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-17-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-17-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 食事利用の案内をお持ちしました。入れる場所はこちらの範囲です。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-17-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here is the meal-use guidance. These are the areas you may enter.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-17-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-17-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この場所で待てるんですね。家族がお風呂から出たら、どこで会えば分かりやすいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-17-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 利用可能な待合せ場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-17-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I can wait here. Where would be easy to meet when my family finishes bathing?
DLG-SC-LOC-011-17-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for a permitted meeting place.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-17-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-17-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内の休憩席で合流できます。浴室側へ探しに行かず、連絡してお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-17-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can meet at the rest seats in the guide. Don't search on the bathing side; contact them and wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-17-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-17-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では案内された区分で受付します。私は休憩席で待つと家族へ伝え、合流してから食事にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-17-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認した区分で受付し浴室へ行かず待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-17-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll register under the indicated category. I'll tell my family I'm waiting at the rest seats, and we'll eat after meeting.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-17-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will register in the confirmed category and wait without entering the baths.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-17-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-17-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 食事利用として承りました。こちらの案内を持って休憩席へお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-17-001-SHARED-11.translation: Accepted as meal use. Take this guidance and go to the rest seats.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-18-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-18-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約はお一人で二泊ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-18-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your booking is one person for two nights.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-18-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-18-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。二日目だけ友人も泊まりたいのですが、人数の変更を相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-18-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二泊のうち一泊だけ人数を増やしたいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-18-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. A friend would like to stay only the second night too. Could we discuss changing the number of guests?
DLG-SC-LOC-011-18-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about adding one guest for only one of two nights.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-18-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-18-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご友人の到着と出発の日を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-18-001-SHARED-03.translation: Tell me your friend's arrival and departure dates.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-18-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-18-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 土曜日に来て日曜日に帰ります。私は金曜から日曜までで、最初の夜は一人です。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-18-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 追加客の到着と出発を日付で説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-18-001-SHARED-04.translation: They arrive Saturday and leave Sunday. I'm Friday through Sunday, alone the first night.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-18-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the additional guest's arrival and departure dates in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-18-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-18-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一泊目は一人、二泊目は二人のご希望ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-18-001-SHARED-05.translation: You want one person the first night and two the second, then.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-18-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-18-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。予約全体を二人に直して、友人の分も二泊にしないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-18-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二泊分追加ではないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-18-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Please don't change the whole booking to two and count my friend for two nights too.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-18-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that this is not two nights of extra occupancy.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-18-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-18-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お部屋の定員と、追加の対応が可能か確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-18-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check room capacity and whether the addition can be accommodated.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-18-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-18-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今の部屋で寝具を用意できるかと、その一泊分の料金を聞いてから変更したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-18-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 寝具と料金を変更前に照会する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-18-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to hear whether bedding can be prepared in the current room and the one-night cost before making the change.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-18-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about bedding and charges before changing.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-18-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-18-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へ照会します。回答までは、ご友人の宿泊は確定していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-18-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll ask the person responsible. Until the response, your friend's stay is not confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-18-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-18-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人にも確認中と伝えます。金曜一人、土曜二人の内容と寝具・料金が分かったら、変更をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-18-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 日別人数の確認後に変更を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-18-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll tell my friend it's being checked too. Once we know Friday one, Saturday two, bedding and charge, I'd like to request the change.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-18-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request the change in Japanese after checking guest numbers by day.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-18-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-18-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その日別人数で照会を受け付けました。結果をご説明しますので、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-18-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've accepted the inquiry with those daily numbers. Please wait here for the result.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-19-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-19-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ち帰りのご注文でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-011-19-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-19-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 冷たいミルク入りの飲み物を買って、後で飲みたいです。蓋があれば、かばんに入れておけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-19-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 後で飲む持帰り飲料を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-19-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like a cold milk drink to have later. With a lid, can I keep it in my bag?
DLG-SC-LOC-011-19-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about a takeaway drink to consume later.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-19-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-19-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 飲むのは何時ごろのご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-19-001-SHARED-03.translation: About what time do you plan to drink it?

DLG-SC-LOC-011-19-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-19-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: これから用事が二つあり、三時間ほど後です。今受け取って、その間は持ち歩くつもりでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-19-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受取から飲むまでの予定時間を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-19-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have two errands now, so about three hours later. I planned to receive it now and carry it meanwhile.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-19-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the planned time from collection to drinking in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-19-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-19-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 蓋は長時間の保存を保証する物ではありません。持ち方や飲む時期も含めてご検討ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-19-001-SHARED-05.translation: A lid doesn't guarantee long storage. Consider how you'll carry it and when you'll drink it too.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-19-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-19-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こぼれない蓋なら保存も大丈夫と思っていました。受け取ってすぐ飲めないなら、今の注文は見送れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-19-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 蓋の役割と保存の扱いを区別して尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-19-001-SHARED-06.translation: I thought a non-spill lid meant storage was fine. If I can't drink it immediately after receiving, can I forgo the current order?
DLG-SC-LOC-011-19-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the lid's role and storage in Japanese and ask.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-19-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-19-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まだ作り始めていませんので、見送れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-19-001-SHARED-07.translation: We haven't started making it, so you can decline.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-19-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-19-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では今はその飲み物を頼みません。すぐ食べる焼き菓子だけを選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-19-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 注文を後の時間に見送り今は別の物を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-19-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I won't order that drink now. I'd like only a baked sweet to eat immediately.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-19-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will defer the drink until later and choose something else now.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-19-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-19-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの表示をご覧ください。飲み物は後で改めてご注文いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-19-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please look at these labels. You can order the drink later again.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-19-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-19-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この焼き菓子一つにします。飲み物は用事の後、すぐ飲める時に買いに戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-19-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 飲む直前に再注文すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-19-001-SHARED-10.translation: One of these baked sweets. I'll return after my errands when I can drink immediately to buy the drink.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-19-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide in Japanese to reorder immediately before drinking.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-19-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-19-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 焼き菓子一つで承りました。飲み物のご注文は取り下げています。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-19-001-SHARED-11.translation: One baked sweet accepted. The drink order is withdrawn.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-20-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-20-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 配布する図面を確認しましょう。どちらを持っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-20-001-SHARED-01.translation: Let's check the drawings to distribute. Which do you have?

DLG-SC-LOC-011-20-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-20-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: こちらの印刷日が新しいので、この束を班へ配ろうと思っています。これでよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-20-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 日付の新しい図面を配ってよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-20-001-SHARED-02.translation: This has the newer print date, so I'm planning to give this stack to the team. Is that all right?
DLG-SC-LOC-011-20-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you may distribute drawings with a newer date.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-20-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-20-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 印刷日だけでは使用する版は決められません。版の番号も見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-20-001-SHARED-03.translation: Print date alone doesn't decide the version to use. Check the version number too.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-20-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-20-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 片方は第二版、こちらは第三版です。新しい日に印刷したという理由だけで選んでいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-20-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 新旧二版と印刷日の根拠を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-20-001-SHARED-04.translation: One is version two, and this is version three. I chose only because it was printed on a newer day.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-20-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the two versions and your print-date reasoning in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-20-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-20-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 第三版の承認欄は、どうなっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-20-001-SHARED-05.translation: What is the approval field on version three like?

DLG-SC-LOC-011-20-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-20-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 空欄です。第二版には承認の印があります。どちらを使うか、班長に確認していただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-20-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 承認欄を示し使用版の判断を班長へ求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-20-001-SHARED-06.translation: Blank. Version two has an approval stamp. I'd like the team leader to confirm which to use.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-20-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the approval field and ask in Japanese for the leader's version decision.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-20-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-20-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 配布は止めて、二版とも班長へ示します。もう作業を始めた班はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-20-001-SHARED-07.translation: Stop distribution and show both versions to the leader. Has any team already started work?

DLG-SC-LOC-011-20-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-20-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一つの班が第二版を持っています。第三版へ直すと決めず、確認中と連絡してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-20-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 古い版を使い始めた班へ保留の連絡を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-20-001-SHARED-08.translation: One team has version two. Rather than decide to change to three, please tell them it's under confirmation.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-20-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for a hold message to the team that started using the older version.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-20-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-20-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当範囲を確認してから、使用する版を班長が指示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-20-001-SHARED-09.translation: After confirming the responsible scope, the team leader will instruct which version to use.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-20-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-20-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 指示された版だけを配ります。差替えが必要なら古い紙を回収し、二版が作業台に混ざらないよう分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-20-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認版だけを配り旧版は区別して回収する段取りを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-20-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll distribute only the instructed version. If replacement is needed, I'll collect the old papers and separate them so the versions don't mix on workbenches.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-20-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Describe in Japanese distributing only the verified version and separately collecting old ones.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-20-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-20-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 配布保留の報告を受けました。二つの束を区別したまま、班長の確認へお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-20-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've received the distribution hold report. Keep the two stacks distinct and bring them for the leader's confirmation.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-21-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-21-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 家賃のお振込みについてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-21-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're asking about rent transfers, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-011-21-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-21-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 毎月同じ口座へ送るので、定期的に振り込む設定ができるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-21-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家賃を毎月送る設定を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-21-001-SHARED-02.translation: I send to the same account every month, so I'd like to know whether recurring transfer settings are possible.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-21-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about a setting to send rent monthly.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-21-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-21-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 金額と、最初に送る日を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-21-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's confirm the amount and first transfer date.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-21-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-21-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今月は途中から住むので二万円、来月からは六万円です。最初の二万円を毎月の金額に書きそうでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-21-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 初月の日割額と通常額の違いを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-21-001-SHARED-04.translation: This month I move in partway, so 20,000 yen; from next month 60,000. I nearly entered the first 20,000 as the monthly amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-21-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show in Japanese the difference between first-month prorated and usual amounts.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-21-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-21-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 継続する金額とは分けて、ご希望を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-21-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll ask your wishes separately from the continuing amount.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-21-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-21-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 毎月六万円は来月からにしたいです。今月の二万円は、一回だけの振込みとして相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-21-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 定期設定とは別に初回を扱う希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-21-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like monthly 60,000 starting next month. This month's 20,000 should be discussed as a one-time transfer.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-21-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the initial transfer should be handled separately from recurring settings.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-21-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-21-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの二つの依頼内容をご覧ください。受取人は同じでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-21-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please review these two requests. Is the recipient the same?

DLG-SC-LOC-011-21-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-21-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同じです。一回分は今月、毎月分は来月からですね。一回分にも毎月という印が付いていたら、直していただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-21-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二つの依頼の開始時期と回数を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-21-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. One-time this month, monthly from next month. If the one-time request has a monthly mark, I'd like it corrected.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-21-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Compare in Japanese the start timing and frequency of both requests.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-21-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-21-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 一回分の継続指定はありません。実際の受付方法と日程を担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-21-001-SHARED-09.translation: The one-time request has no recurring designation. The adviser will check actual acceptance and scheduling.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-21-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-21-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この内容でお願いします。受付後は二つの控えを分けて見て、金額と開始月を確認してから管理会社へ知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-21-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 初回と継続分の控えを分けて確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-21-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please proceed with that. After acceptance, I'll review the two receipts separately and check amounts and start months before telling the management company.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-21-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check initial and recurring receipts separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-21-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-21-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 初回の一回分と、翌月からの継続分として担当へおつなぎします。資料をお持ちになってお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-21-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll connect you to staff for the first one-time amount and next-month continuing amount. Please keep your documents and wait.
